events.content:
Category pages are now pre-rendered for each slug, and their links prefetch those pages before selection. The browser URL remains `/catalog?category=...`; a rewrite maps it to the matching static category page. The catalog no longer has the loading fallback or delayed product fetch, and `/catalog` still shows featured products by default.

The changes are in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx), [app/catalog/[category]/page.tsx](/workspace/app/catalog/[category]/page.tsx), [app/catalog/catalog-results.tsx](/workspace/app/catalog/catalog-results.tsx), [lib/data.ts](/workspace/lib/data.ts), and [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts). I didn’t run a build or tests.
